<!-- pr-reviewer: 764df9f4ebf32b22a550bc816d9fd86a67cc42aa -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is the second safety-floor review at this head. The PR ships the post changes from #2342. Those changes affect posted G-code. Your clean marker at this head does not hold on Windows.

**Finding 1 (blocker): the #2342 Windows golden defect is present at this head.** The wrapped-A code in assets/posts/tormach.cps at this head is the same code that the review of #2342 at `f29c92bd` found red on Windows. `microarc_test_part::a_wrapped_op_on_the_test_part_posts_wrapped_a` fails on this machine:

```text
crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/wrap_rotary_parallel_microarc4.nc: line 661: F209.668 != F209.79 (allowance 0.04)
test result: FAILED. 2 passed; 1 failed
```

The split loop at assets/posts/tormach.cps:872 (`while (n < TURN_MAX && !(turnBow(...) <= TURN_TOL)) n *= 2;`) is 1-ULP sensitive. One libm difference flips the split count and changes whole adjacent F words. The absolute 0.04 allowance in compare_wrap_golden (crates/app/tests/microarc_test_part.rs:278-279) does not bound that spread. The fix belongs in #2342 (a margin or quantization in the bow test, or a delta bounded relative to the F value). Refresh this child after that fix. #2342 is open with `needs-rework` for the same defect.

**Not a silent wrong output.** The feed law holds on both platforms. The trajectory bound in turnLength is platform-stable, and the dense-sampling tests pass here. This is a test-portability defect on a shipped golden.

**What holds on Windows (this review, trial merge with main `a8bb30f0c`, clean).**

- continuous_4axis_part: 7 passed. The new wrapped_nc::compare allows only exact rate-limited swaps. It is green here.
- tormach_wrapped_a: 11 passed, with the trajectory test in metric and inch units.
- first_4axis_part 4, fourth_axis_pose 9, index_swing 13, recorded_post_streams 5, rotary_feed_cap 11, tormach_post 10: all pass.
- microarc_test_part: 2 passed, 1 failed (Finding 1).
- All camcraft-post suites pass on Windows, with script_tormach 11 and the recorded streams.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The guide claims check out by eye: the air-cut warning, the honest simulator status ("written from four test moves... No complete program has been run in the simulator or on a machine yet"), and the `Refs #1904` body wording.
- Not run here: the site Python scripts and the picture script. A review does not run scripts a PR adds. The three known site failures are tracked in #2345.

**Requested before merge.**

1. Land the split-loop/comparator fix in #2342. Then refresh this branch onto that head and re-run the wrapped golden on both Linux and Windows.
2. In the same fix, close the latent finding from the #2342 review: a turning rapid after a turning G93 feed does not restate G94 (tormach.cps motionFor restates only when `!aNext`). No test pins it. Add the restatement or a refusal with a test.

**Label note.** This PR keeps the `merge-ready` label your review set. This review adds `needs-rework` for Finding 1. Under AGENTS.md that pair is a disagreement: /merge-ready will not offer this PR while both stand. The two accounts decide on the PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
